h1: Interior design and custom furniture for clients in Germany

blocks.text: Interior design and custom furniture for clients in Germany

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN is an interior design studio and furniture manufacturer based in Bratislava. For clients in Germany, we develop interior design projects remotely, make the furniture at our own production facility, and deliver it anywhere in Germany. Delivery is included in the price: you get a single all-in price for the furniture, installation included.

Completed projects include a 160 m² private house in Munich and a 215 m² house in Berlin: interior design, technical documentation, custom furniture, and turnkey renovation. We communicate in Russian, Ukrainian, or English.

blocks.text: How we work on properties in Germany

items: Online consultation. We discuss your project by video call or messenger. You send us a floor plan, photos, and your wishes.
Design project. Layout, concept, 3D visualizations, and technical documentation — everything is approved remotely, and revisions are made based on your comments.

Furniture. Based on the project, we make kitchens, wardrobes, walk-in closets, and other furniture in Bratislava. Before production, we confirm the dimensions — from your measurements or with a site visit by our specialist.
Delivery and installation. We bring the furniture to any city in Germany and install it with our own crew. Delivery is already included in the price.
Turnkey renovation. For larger properties, our crews can carry out the full implementation — as in our projects in Munich and Berlin.

blocks.text: What you can order from Germany

items: Interior design project for an apartment or house — from the layout to working drawings.
3D visualization of an interior or a house facade.
A custom kitchen — a bespoke design or one of the 32 models in our catalog, with delivery and installation.
Custom furniture — wardrobes, walk-in closets, entrance hall furniture, TV walls, and furniture for bedrooms and home offices.
Complete implementation — design, furniture, and renovation by one team.

parts.html: Interior design packages cost the same as for Bratislava and Vienna: from €20/m². Furniture is priced based on the project, and delivery to Germany is already included.

blocks.text: Questions about working with clients in Germany

items.q: How much does furniture delivery to Germany cost?
items.a: Delivery is included in the price of the furniture regardless of the city — Berlin, Munich, Hamburg, Frankfurt, or a small town. You get one all-in price for the pieces, including delivery and installation.

items.q: How do you take measurements if you are in Bratislava?
items.a: For the design project, a floor plan and photos are enough. Before furniture production, we confirm the dimensions either from your own measurements taken according to our instructions or with a site visit by our specialist.
Our own crew from Bratislava. We schedule the installation for the delivery date so that everything is installed in a single visit.

items.q: Can I order just the design project?
items.a: Yes. You will receive a complete set of visualizations and drawings that a local contractor in Germany can work from.
The design project takes from 14 days for the “Express” package; a full project usually takes 4–8 weeks. Furniture production time depends on the scope of the order and is confirmed with the quote.

items.q: What languages do you work in?
items.a: Russian, Ukrainian, and English. Documentation for German contractors is prepared with dimensions and specifications that are clear without translation.
